analysis_result.analysis: The model’s reasoning fails at multiple levels. Second, it misidentifies the actual visible faces of the cubes — especially Cube 3 — by assigning red to the front face instead of the bottom face. This leads to the erroneous conclusion that one red face is visible (when it’s actually hidden) and that two others are hidden (when none are). The core error is textual logic: the model constructs a false premise (one red face per cube) and then misapplies it to mislabeled visual data, compounding the error.
